The '''Triumph Crate''' is a special time-limited crate released in February 2015 (coinciding with a Volt Coin sale). It consists of a re-release of some popular units from previous crates (and also some not-as-popular units).

Cost: 60 Volt Coins per open

Contents:
* [[Cerebral]] x1
* [[Defiance]] x1
* [[Phalanx]] x2
* [[Nostromos]] x2
* [[Slab]] x4
* [[Mercator]] x4
* [[Inquisitor]] x4
* [[Blastback]] x8
* [[Launcher]] x8
* [[Char Infantry]] x8
* [[Mantis]] x8
